{{Quote|Now, I appear to have upheld ''my'' part of the deal&hellip;''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>''And I shall keep mine!'' Just give me 12 hours and the order will be good to go!|Reep Tonith and Tarin|<ref name="A Trooper's Tale" />}}
'''Tarin''' was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] in charge of the production of [[FEX-M3 nerve gas grenade]]s during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Reep Tonith]] threatened to turn him in to [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] if he did not complete the order soon. He was later shackled by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Marrt]] as the [[Czerka factory]] burnt down. At some point the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] interrogated him, but he gave away little information about his crimes.<ref name="A Trooper's Tale" />
